Subject: DeltaPay - BCP/DR evidence request (RTO/RPO + SIG/CAIQ follow-ups)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick tour last week. DeltaPay's InfoSec team is closing our vendor review this month and we need a small bundle of artifacts to complete the BCP/DR section for our procurement record. Can you share the following by COB Friday (our side)?

Must-haves:
- RTO/RPO matrix for production services (per-region, per-tier) — ideally an XLSX we can consume.
- Evidence of the most recent failover test(s) (logs/traces or consolidated runbook outputs) and a short note on runbook owner.
- Warm-cache/kv-warming timing measurements and any mitigations for cold-starts that affect RTO.
- Restore timing CSV for S3-store backups (a few sample runs).

We also have a quick SIG/CAIQ follow-up: does Redwood maintain a SOC 2 addendum for DR claims (attestation / authorized signer)? Our auditor (cc'd) may ask for a signature.

Attachments we received in the demo (for reference): N/A — please attach the artifacts in one reply.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
VP, Risk & Compliance — DeltaPay
samir.khan@deltapay.com

Hi Samir — thanks for the list. We can provide all of that. Two quick clarifications so we package exactly what you need:

1) RTO/RPO matrix: do you want these grouped by customer SLA tier (standard/premium/dedicated) or by internal service component (control plane, KV cache, model-serving, object store)? We can deliver both but shipping both increases the XLSX size.
2) For the SOC2 addendum: we have a standard DR attestation PDF signed by our Security Director; auditors sometimes ask for it plus the underlying evidence pack. Is a signed PDF sufficient for your auditor, or do they require a DocuSign envelope?

Proposed plan: I will loop in our ops lead (marcus_lin) and operations manager (tessa_morgan) to run a final extract and attach the artifacts. We can deliver a consolidated ZIP with: rto_rpo_matrix_v1.xlsx, dr_runbook_v3.pdf (annotated), warmcache_traces_20270712.zip, s3_restore_timings.csv.

Target: send consolidated package by EOD Thursday (7/15) PST and follow up with a 30-minute walkthrough Friday if you want to go through the traces.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Mina — packaging below and answering inline where helpful.

1) rto_rpo_matrix_v1.xlsx — attached (sheet per region + SLA tier). Key points:
   - Control plane RTO target (standard): 30m; premium/dedicated: 5m (failover to dedicated pool).
   - Model-serving RTO varies by model size; matrix includes median warmup numbers and quantization layer notes.

2) warmcache_traces_20270712.zip — attached. Notes:
   - Sample run shows KV warm from cold to 90% hit-rate in ~12 minutes for active model keys on our 8-GPU pool.
   - We include the trace extraction script and annotated timeline (trace_readme.txt).

3) s3_restore_timings.csv — attached. This is 3 sample restore runs from our staging region (obj-store tier: standard): restores complete to usable state in 18–24 minutes; full consistency verification scripts add 6–8 minutes.

4) dr_runbook_v3.pdf — latest annotated runbook attached (owner: ops-services@redwood.com; contact: Marcus Lin).

Short answers to Samir's clarifying Qs:
- Grouping: the XLSX includes both service-component and SLA-tier views (tab names: service_view, sla_view).
- SOC2 addendum: not included here — Irene is preparing the signed attestation.
